scope: small, easy-to-see wood, thorn, or plant splinter in an easily accessible area
patterns: how do I remove a splinter
tiny bit of wood in hand
response: Wash your hands and the area with soap and water. Use clean tweezers to pull the splinter out in the same direction it went in. Rinse again and cover with a clean bandage if needed. Do not dig deeply into the skin.
red_flags: glass, metal, or a splinter you cannot remove easily
splinter near the eye or in a joint
deep splinter that will not come out or is bleeding a lot
increasing redness, warmth, swelling, or pus after removal
uncertain tetanus status with a dirty wound
